decisions.reason: The vertigo combination tablet sits close to the firm's core prescription portfolio and has a dedicated page, so keeping it costs little while its market uptake after the 2024 launch is still uncertain, which makes it worth holding as an option.

The generic antidepressant is distant from the established offer and faces tender pricing risk, but approval costs are already sunk and it is only one year on the market, so too little has been learned yet to justify abandoning it.
The combination antihypertensive is close to the firm's competencies and supports its focus on adherence, so keeping it is cheap and its upside has not yet been resolved.

The bone and joint supplement fits the strategy of pharmacy-exclusive self-care products and costs little to keep, so despite its lower visibility on the website it remains a cheap option while its demand is still unclear.
